instructions.name: claim
docs: After the day (plus grace), the best score takes the SOL pot.

instructions.name: claim_delegated
docs: claim signed by the delegated browser key; the SOL pot goes to the owner, never elsewhere.

instructions.name: claim_token
docs: After the day (plus grace), the best score takes the token pot (classic SPL or Token-2022).

instructions.name: claim_token_delegated
docs: claim_token signed by the delegated browser key; the pot goes to the owner's token account.

instructions.name: delegate
docs: One wallet approval for a run of Daily entries: a browser key may enter today's pools, post the
verified score and claim for this owner, `max_entries` times until `expires_at`. SOL entries and
the rent the browser key pays come out of the lamports escrowed here; token entries move the
owner's tokens through the SPL delegate approval the owner gives this account in the same
transaction. Delegating again replaces the key and limits. Never required: the owner-signed
instructions keep working.

instructions.name: enter
docs: Stake SOL into today's pool. One entry per wallet per day per asset.

instructions.name: enter_delegated
docs: A delegated SOL entry: the browser key signs and pays rent, the stake comes from the escrow.

instructions.name: enter_token
docs: Stake a registered token (test USDC or CASH) into today's pool for that mint.

accounts.name: token_config
docs: The mint's registration: its stake and whether it takes entries.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The pool's token vault, an associated token account owned by the pool PDA.

instructions.name: enter_token_delegated
docs: A delegated token entry: the browser key signs and pays rent; the stake leaves the owner's token
account through the delegate approval held by the delegation PDA.

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: The owner's token account; the SPL delegate it approved is this delegation PDA.

instructions.name: post_score
docs: Post the one shot. `score` is the replay-verified P&L in cents; the verifier must co-sign.

accounts.name: verifier
docs: The off-chain replay verifier. Its signature says the score was rebuilt from the run log.

instructions.name: post_score_delegated
docs: post_score signed by the delegated browser key instead of the owner; the verifier still co-signs.
An expired delegation may still post and claim: expiry only stops new entries.

accounts.name: verifier
docs: The off-chain replay verifier, as for post_score.

instructions.name: refund
docs: A day nobody posted a clean shot in pays nobody, so after the day (plus grace) each entrant takes an equal share
of the SOL pot back (the last refund takes any remainder) and their entry closes. Anyone may send it (the
player, their browser key, a crank): the stake and the entry's rent only ever go to the entrant.

instructions.name: refund_token
docs: The token-pool refund: the share leaves the pool's vault for the entrant's associated token account.

instructions.name: revoke_delegation
docs: The owner takes the delegation back; the escrow and the account's rent return to the owner.

instructions.name: set_fee
docs: The pot fee: `fee_bps` of each claimed pot goes to `treasury`. A new rate takes effect with the next UTC day's
pools, so nobody who already entered pays a fee they did not see; a treasury-only change keeps the day.

instructions.name: set_token
docs: Register a token pool (classic SPL or Token-2022 mint) with its entry stake, or change it.
A disabled token keeps its past pools claimable but takes no new entries.

errors.name: WrongDay
errors.msg: You can only enter today's pool

errors.name: DayOver
errors.msg: Posting for this day has ended

errors.name: AlreadyPosted
errors.msg: This entry already posted its one shot

errors.name: DayNotOver
errors.msg: The day is not over yet

errors.name: NotWinner
errors.msg: Only the best score can claim

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Wrong token mint for this pool

errors.name: TokenOff
errors.msg: This token pool is not taking entries

errors.name: BadDelegation
errors.msg: Delegation limits are out of range

errors.name: DelegationUsedUp
errors.msg: This delegation has used all its entries

errors.name: EscrowEmpty
errors.msg: The delegation's SOL escrow can't cover this entry

errors.name: PotHasScores
errors.msg: Someone posted a score: the best one takes this pot

errors.name: NothingToRefund
errors.msg: Nothing left to refund in this pool

errors.name: WrongTreasury
errors.msg: That is not the fee treasury

types.name: Delegation
docs: One wallet's standing approval: a browser key, how many entries it may make and until when. The
account's lamports above rent are the SOL escrow for delegated SOL entries.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: The pot fee (v4): `fee_bps` of each claimed pot goes to `treasury`, for pools of `since_day` and later. Its own PDA
(seeds "fee"), so every v3 account keeps its layout.

types.name: TokenConfig
docs: One registered token pool: the mint, its entry stake in the mint's base units, and whether it is open.
